JoJo's Bizarre Adventure is pretty much universally praised, but for those of you who haven't seen it, check this show out. It's an amazing action shounen with exemplary characters, an enthralling story and setting, and it traverses the entire emotional spectrum (from hilarity to gravity) with grace. This is also the manliest thing you will ever watch. If you like chivalry, honor, and justice, then JoJo's Bizarre Adventure is definitely for you. If you're into awesome. scream-filled, superpower-fueled battles, you'll love it. If you enjoy a variety of characters with unique personalities that can be funny at times, and scary at others, then, seriously, watch this show.

The only (almost) drawback to this show is that it's pretty much completely surface-level. By that I mean, don't take this show too seriously. I don't really see it as trying to make some deeper statement beyond utter manliness. It can be silly at times, so don't take it too seriously. Once you let go and just ride along with the ridiculous, testerone-packed awesomeness, it'll win you over, too. Regardless of its relative shallowness, this show still manages to induce a multitude of emotions in me that most shows fail to achieve. You will laugh. You will cry. You'll scream in victory and defeat along with JoJo. Watch this show.
